reason: The preregistered H4 outside midpoint-reversion base was positive in 2024-2025 but failed the full gate. This audit maps continuation versus reversion mechanics and cannot promote a variant.
shared_setup: A closed H4 bar has high >= previous H4 high, low <= previous H4 low, positive range, and closes in the top 20% or bottom 20% of its range.

mechanisms.rule: At H4 close, top-20% outside bar enters SHORT immediately; bottom-20% outside bar enters LONG immediately.
Top-20% outside bar waits up to 16 existing M15 bars for the first close below the H4 midpoint with bearish body >= 0.20 M15 ATR, then SHORT. Bottom-20% is symmetric LONG.
Top-20% outside bar waits up to 16 existing M15 bars for first close >= H4 high + 0.10 M15 ATR, then LONG. Bottom-20% waits for close <= H4 low - 0.10 ATR, then SHORT.
Top-20% outside bar waits up to 16 existing M15 bars for first bar with high >= H4 high and close < H4 high, then SHORT. Bottom-20% waits for low <= H4 low and close > H4 low, then LONG.

interpretation_boundary: No mechanism can replace or rescue the failed formal base.
Do not choose maximum PF mechanism as a candidate.
A positive mechanism is only a lead for a separately preregistered fresh prospective development cycle.
No MT5 orders, live trading, live-ready, final signal or Discord.
